name: Gastric Juice
doc: Gastric Juice (Gayla's enemy attack): the root and the target task - the juice sprayed from the caster's mouth in streams, its drips and splashes, the target melting (its model redrawn), the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag128_gastric_juice.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools, stream points and melt amounts in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Target
parts.doc: The juice sprayed from the caster's mouth in streams, its drips and splashes, the target melting; the sound; the damage

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage at this tick of the target task
